summary: High Tide Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 6, 2026, announcing preliminary unaudited tonnage data from its 51%-owned German subsidiary, Remexian Pharma GmbH, for the second fiscal quarter ended April 30, 2026. Remexian sold 7.6 tonnes of medical cannabis in Germany, a record, with sequential growth of 21% and year-over-year growth of 49%. The announcement discusses operational performance and market expansion in Germany. No special situation event — such as acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or management change — is present. No board recommendation, advisor, deal terms, or structural mechanics are provided. This is a routine operational update.
